title.zh: FineLoom 企业级 AI Agent 平台

summary.zh: 企业级 Agent 平台，包含管理端、PC/H5、Electron 桌面端、MCP Hub、Skill Hub 和网关。运行时分 iCat 与 DSH 两支。
summary.en: An enterprise agent platform with an admin console, PC and H5 clients, an Electron desktop app, an MCP Hub, a Skill Hub, and a gateway. Two runtimes: iCat and DSH.

problem.zh: 平台要同时放下两种运行方式：iCat 用 Kafka worker 常驻处理；DSH 基于开源 deepseek-harness，每个用户一个容器。管理端、网页端和桌面端接到同一套网关，并提供 MCP 与技能能力。
problem.en: The platform had to host two runtimes at once. iCat keeps Kafka workers running. DSH is based on the open-source project deepseek-harness, with one container per user. Admin, web, and desktop clients share a gateway, alongside MCP and skill hubs.

role.zh: 按提交次数是这个仓库的第 3 名贡献者，共 25 次（2026-06 至 2026-10）。
role.en: Third by commit count on this repository: 25 commits, from June through October 2026.

role.zh: 桌面端打包，以及 NSIS 安装包。
role.en: Desktop packaging, and the NSIS installer.

role.zh: FineNote 笔记服务。
role.en: The FineNote note service.

role.zh: 企业微信单点登录和工作台集成。
role.en: WeCom single sign-on and workbench integration.

role.zh: Docker 构建与运行上的优化。
role.en: Docker build and runtime optimization.

caption.zh: iCat 走 Kafka worker。DSH 由控制器按用户起容器，上游是 deepseek-harness。
caption.en: iCat is Kafka workers. DSH starts a container per user through a controller. Upstream is deepseek-harness.

note.zh: DSH 基于开源项目 deepseek-harness（上游许可证 MIT），每个用户一个容器。本页只说明架构和我的职责，不包含代码、仓库或内部地址。
note.en: DSH is based on the open-source project deepseek-harness (upstream license: MIT), with one container per user. This page covers architecture and my part in it. It does not include code, a repository, or internal addresses.

summary.zh: 识别光交箱巡检照片里的异常。YOLO 与 Qwen-VL 各一套，并识别二维码。客户是某省运营商。
summary.en: Finds anomalies in optical cross-connect cabinet inspection photos. One YOLO pipeline and one Qwen-VL pipeline, plus QR decoding. The client was a provincial telecom operator.

problem.zh: 巡检会积累大量光交箱照片。系统从照片里标出异常，并用 pyzbar 读取二维码。检测有两个版本：YOLO，以及后来的 Qwen-VL 多模态版本。
problem.en: Inspections accumulate cabinet photos. The service marks anomalies in a photo and reads QR codes with pyzbar. There are two detectors: YOLO, and a later Qwen-VL multimodal version.

role.zh: 提交了立项。
role.en: Opened the project.

role.zh: 完成多模态版本 VL 1.1.0 的生产发布。
role.en: Shipped the multimodal VL 1.1.0 production release.

role.zh: 我在这个仓库有 6 次提交。检测功能的主要开发是同事做的，这里不把模型实现写成我的个人作品。
role.en: I have six commits in the repository. A teammate led the detector work, so the model implementation is not presented as my own product.

caption.zh: 同一张巡检照片可以走 YOLO 或 Qwen-VL。二维码识别并行于检测。页面不用现场照片。
caption.en: The same inspection photo can go through YOLO or Qwen-VL. QR decoding sits beside detection. This page uses no field photos.

note.zh: 案例不使用任何现场照片。
note.en: The case uses no field photos.

summary.zh: 测算政企项目的成本与价格：分位价格异常、Qwen 产品名匹配、向量检索推荐、多级审批。大模型网关支持国密 SM4。客户是某省运营商。
summary.en: Estimates cost and price for a carrier’s enterprise and government projects: percentile price anomalies, Qwen product-name matching, vector-search recommendations, and multi-level approval. The LLM gateway supports SM4. The client was a provincial telecom operator.

problem.zh: 政企报价要对照历史价格发现异常价，把不统一的产品名对齐，给出推荐，并按层级审批。调用大模型的网关需要支持国密 SM4。
problem.en: Pricing for enterprise and government accounts has to spot outliers against historical prices, align inconsistent product names, offer recommendations, and pass multi-level approval. The gateway in front of the model has to support SM4.

role.en: 22 backend commits from July through September 2026.

role.en: Introduced the LlmGateway abstraction.

role.zh: 修复 Tomcat 的 CLOSE_WAIT 连接泄漏。
role.en: Fixed a Tomcat CLOSE_WAIT connection leak.

role.zh: 适配 Nginx 二级路径部署。
role.en: Adapted deployment to an Nginx subpath.

caption.zh: 页面经 Nginx 进入 Spring Boot。测算、审批、网关和向量检索在同一套服务里。
caption.en: The page reaches Spring Boot through Nginx. Estimation, approval, the gateway, and vector search live in that service.

note.zh: 上面列的是系统能力和我提交过的部分。没有对外的效果数字。
note.en: The list above is the system’s capability and the parts I committed. There are no published outcome numbers.

summary.zh: 把自然语言转成可校验的 SQL：九类知识对象做元数据，三层校验，黄金集回归，并用 MCP 对外提供工具。样例数据是模拟的商业银行取数场景。
summary.en: Turns natural language into SQL that can be checked: nine knowledge objects as metadata, three validation layers, and golden-set regression, exposed as MCP tools. The sample data is a simulated commercial-bank retrieval scenario.

problem.zh: 直接采用模型写出的 SQL 难以审计。生成需要被元数据约束，执行前做三层校验，并用一套固定的黄金集做回归。
problem.en: SQL written straight by a model is hard to audit. Generation has to be constrained by metadata, checked in three layers before it runs, and regressed against a fixed golden set.

role.zh: 按个人方案和演示来写。工作副本不是独立的 git 仓库，没有提交记录可以核对。
role.en: Presented as a personal proposal and demo. The working copy was not its own git repository, so there is no commit history to cite.

role.zh: 数据是模拟的，不是生产库。
role.en: The data is simulated, not a production database.

related.zh: 同一方向上还有一个独立的 NL2SQL MCP 服务：符合 MCP 标准，把自然语言转成 SQL，对象是运营商的数据仓库。它和 TrustSQL 放在一起说明，不单独列成案例。
related.en: In the same direction, a separate NL2SQL MCP server turns natural language into SQL for a telecom operator’s data warehouse. It is grouped with TrustSQL rather than listed as its own case.

caption.zh: 问题先落到九类知识对象上，再生成 SQL、做三层校验，并用黄金集回归。对外是 MCP 工具。
caption.en: A question lands on nine knowledge objects, then becomes SQL, passes three checks, and is regressed on a golden set. The outside interface is MCP.

note.zh: 后端是 Python。接口形态从目录看接近 FastAPI，依赖清单没有单独核对，所以技术栈里不写成已经确认的 FastAPI。没有公开仓库链接。
note.en: The backend is Python. The layout looks like FastAPI, but the dependency manifest was not checked, so the stack does not claim FastAPI as confirmed. There is no public repository link.

summary.zh: 把 iPhone 原片增量备份到 Mac mini 的 SMB 共享。凭证放在系统钥匙串，传输走 Tailscale。
summary.en: Incrementally backs up original iPhone photos to an SMB share on a Mac mini. Credentials stay in the system keychain. Transfer goes over Tailscale.

problem.zh: 原片体积大，不适合每次整库重拷。需要只同步新增文件，把凭证放进钥匙串，再写到 Mac mini 上的 SMB 目录。
problem.en: Originals are large, so copying the whole library each time is a poor fit. New files should sync on their own, with credentials in the keychain, onto an SMB share on a Mac mini.

role.zh: 个人项目，唯一作者。
role.en: Personal project. Sole author.
Latest recorded activity: 27 October 2026.

caption.zh: 增量同步由 Swift 完成。SMB 客户端使用 AMSMB2。工程用 XcodeGen 生成。
caption.en: Incremental sync is Swift. The SMB client is AMSMB2. The project is generated with XcodeGen.

summary.zh: 检查 COSMIC 功能拆分 Excel 和概要设计 Word 是否一致，并生成 Markdown、JSON、HTML 报告。Windows 和 macOS 都能用。场景是某省运营商的软件造价评估。
summary.en: Checks a COSMIC function-split spreadsheet against an outline-design Word document, then writes Markdown, JSON, and HTML reports. Runs on Windows and macOS. The setting was software cost estimation for a provincial telecom operator.

problem.zh: 造价评估里，功能点拆分表和概要设计需要对得上。这个工具读 Excel 和 Word，把检查结果做成报告。
problem.en: In a cost estimate, the function-point breakdown and the outline design have to agree. The tool reads the spreadsheet and the Word document and writes a report.

role.en: Shown as an internal tool I wrote.

caption.en: The UI may be Tk, or the report may open in a browser. The source notes mention both and do not separate them further.

summary.zh: 接入 RTSP、视频文件或摄像头，检测离岗、区域入侵、人员聚集、明火和吸烟，并把告警推到 Webhook。这是一次概念验证。
summary.en: Takes RTSP, a video file, or a camera, detects someone off post, zone intrusion, crowding, open flame, and smoking, and pushes alerts to a webhook. This was a proof of concept.

problem.zh: 需要一条轻量的巡检链路，对几类明确的情况告警，而不是先搭一整套视频平台。
problem.en: The need was a light inspection path that alerts on a few explicit situations, rather than a full video platform.

role.zh: 作为我编写的概念验证展示。
role.en: Shown as a proof of concept I wrote.

role.zh: 工作副本不是 git 仓库，提交记录无法核对。

caption.zh: 推理使用 Ultralytics YOLOv8，跑在 PyTorch CPU 上。旁边有一个 Web 界面。本页不用现场画面。
caption.en: Inference is Ultralytics YOLOv8 on PyTorch CPU, with a web UI beside it. This page uses no on-site footage.

note.zh: 检测模型是 Ultralytics YOLOv8，许可证为 AGPL-3.0。若放进闭源产品，或作为网络服务对外提供，需要另行确认许可证义务。本页不使用任何现场照片或视频。
note.en: Detection uses Ultralytics YOLOv8, licensed AGPL-3.0. Shipping it inside a closed-source product, or offering it as a network service, needs a separate look at the license. This page uses no on-site photos or video.

summary.zh: 用 Cloudflare R2 在两台机器之间中转大文件或部署包，到期后自动清理。
summary.en: Relays large files or deploy bundles between two machines through Cloudflare R2, then deletes them when they expire.

problem.zh: 两台机器之间要传大文件或部署包，又不希望这些对象一直留在存储里。
problem.en: Two machines need to exchange large files or deploy bundles without leaving the objects in storage indefinitely.

role.zh: 个人基础设施，唯一作者。
role.en: Personal infrastructure. Sole author.
Latest recorded activity: 2 September 2026.

caption.zh: 两边都用 rclone。清理和常驻方式是 systemd。脚本是 Bash。
caption.en: Both sides use rclone. Expiry and the long-running process are systemd. The scripts are Bash.

note.zh: 个人项目，仓库是公开的。
